Messages.Author: LSJ

> Which leads to a sort of followup question - What are the chances of

It is promo-only.
That means it will never be printed in a set.
Just like Dan Murdock and Marianna Gilbert.

It is initially being released at Storyline Tournaments.
It may also be released at future tournaments or through other
promotional means.

>No promo-only cards will be printed in any set.

But it is theoretically possible that:

1.) Dan and Marianna will get printed and distributed in a promo-only fashion,
in accordance with their status?

2.) Is it possible for a promo-only card to have its status changed? If Dan and
Marianna are *changed* to non-promo-only, then they can be printed in any set.
Of course this might cause all sorts of logistical problems but it is at least
possible?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Halcyan 2 wrote:
> But it is theoretically possible that:
>
> 1.) Dan and Marianna will get printed and distributed in a promo-only fashion,
> in accordance with their status?
>
> 2.) Is it possible for a promo-only card to have its status changed? If Dan and
> Marianna are *changed* to non-promo-only, then they can be printed in any set.
> Of course this might cause all sorts of logistical problems but it is at least
> possible?

Well, nothing is guaranteed (in a few centuries, maybe H*Borg will control
the rights to VTES), but the idea is that "promo-only" isn't limited to
"right now". For instance, Lucita wasn't "promo-only", even for the
period between when she appeared as a promo and when she appeared in a
set.

There are no plans to reprint either of the WotC promo-only VTES cards at
this time, AFAIK.



Messages.Author: Curevei
Messages.Body:
>Wow! There's a STORY behind Dan?
>
>Does anyone know what it is? I've always wondered about the whole
>Giants Blood thing.

Been a while, and I only read the book once. So, I'm sure someone will correct
inaccuracies.

Dan was the abandoned childe of a Toreador Methusaleh. He ran around with his
superior Potence*, including throwing a well-aimed car. Late in the book he
gets a thing of Giant's Blood from his sire to help him complete his mission
(can't remember if it had to do with taking out the golden guy or not).

* Yes, vampires can increase their physical attributes. What I recall is him
using his superstrength casually and all of the time.

If the card had POT (bump his cap a bit), it would be fairly thematic as he
showed (really) weak levels of Auspex and Obfuscate.
